about_the_game:
This free demo of Dark Land offers a focused look at the core gameplay experience of the full game. In this limited version, you will face challenging enemies, explore a cursed land, and test your skills in both combat and cooperation.

What’s Included in the Demo:

  • Main Quest: Collect 5 rare items dropped by creatures called Tyran and deliver them to the village NPC to complete your mission.

  • Boss Battles: Confront 2 mini bosses along the way, then face the main boss that guards the final area. Defeating it will complete the demo.

  • Combat & Progression: Equip basic weapons and armor, loot resources, and experience the foundation of Dark Land’s action-RPG combat system.

  • Solo & Co-op Play: Play the demo alone, or team up with a friend in 2-player online/offline co-op.

Approximate Playtime: 30–60 minutes, depending on playstyle.

Not Included in the Demo (Available in Full Game):

  • Extended story chapters and additional regions beyond the starting quest.

  • Full variety of weapons, armor, crafting, and trading systems.

  • Expanded co-op for up to 4 players.

  • Advanced missions, side quests, and large-scale boss encounters.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains fantasy violence typical of the action RPG genre, such as fighting monsters with weapons. 
One male character begins the game shirtless (bare chest, wearing pants) and can later equip armor and clothing during gameplay. 
Depending on player choices, one of the possible story endings depicts the protagonist committing suicide after killing his mother (who has transformed into a demon). 

There is no sexual content, no drug or alcohol use, and no explicit gore.
